title: cherenkov-sim2real: code, configurations and per-seed results for "Carrier-Domain Adaptation Interaction in Classification Under Distribution Shift"

creators.name: Pagliaro, Antonio
creators.affiliation: INAF-IASF Palermo; ICSC National Centre for HPC, Big Data and Quantum Computing

description: Reproducible benchmark of feature-alignment domain adaptation (CORAL, mean matching, MMD) across five carrier classifiers under controlled, physically motivated synthetic shifts of Imaging Atmospheric Cherenkov Telescope tabular features (CTA Prod5 public Monte Carlo). Includes the Hydra configurations, the synthetic perturbation framework, the runner and ablation scripts, one result manifest per (experiment, seed), the consolidated JSON tables and the scripts that regenerate every figure and table of the paper.
